During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], in the mission known as '''Operation Silverplate''', funding for [[Eagle]]'s [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] network, an anti-[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] group, was traced to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] was then sent to identify and eliminate the source. [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] member [[Vector Hyllus]] was chosen to assist the agent.

Cipher Nine and Hyllus identified the local negotiator [[Denri Ayl]] and [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Chay Cortess]] as primary funders of the terrorist network. However, [[House Cortess]] was not implicated as a whole though appropriate responses and precautions were taken by the Sith Empire. After the mission's success, Vector Hyllus became an Imperial asset and was granted transfer from the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service|Diplomatic Service]].
